description: Accent-folded Portuguese words that are not English words, used to flag Portuguese identifiers. Built 2026-09-25 from the dictionary-pt 4.0.0 lemmas intersected with a 50k pt-BR frequency list, minus /usr/share/dict/words, plus reviewed inflections and PT/EN homographs and every word the survey found in code. See docs/plans/2026-09-25-english-identifiers.md, section 1.1.
